title: The Whispering Winds
setting_summary: In the heart of a forgotten forest, encircled by an ancient stone wall, lies the village of Eldoria. Here, the villagers are bound by both tradition and fear, living under the ever-watchful eye of the Council, which controls every aspect of their lives.
